_meta.license_note: Statutory word lists reused under the Open Government Licence.
_meta.purpose: Chapter-structured wordbank for the Hangman spelling game (11+ preparation).
_meta.schema_notes: Each word is now an object with fields: word, ipa, meaning {partOfSpeech, definition, example}, image. Meanings and IPA are embedded so the app needs no dictionary API at runtime. Image is the filename the app expects in assets/images/. v4 adds 'chunks': an array of 1-4 letter spelling chunks. Used by the Spell-Aloud feature to teach pronunciation chunk by chunk. Most chunks come from pyphen British English syllabification; single-syllable and pedagogically tricky words use manual overrides.
